author: Jason Stys
summary: The implementation adds bidirectional collision category and mask filters, versioned scene migration, deterministic state hashes and initial/final overlap CSV inspection.
rationale: Supports practical game-world collision layers and reproducible debugging against independent geometry oracles.
limitations: Category/mask filtering selects AABB query candidates; it does not add physical collision response, enter/exit callbacks or navigation changes.
Filter words change numeric state fingerprints even for legacy default filters; replay input grammar remains version 1.
Raw queries cannot establish current entity-generation validity; World owns lifetime checks. This is a fictional integer 2D game engine.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
